title: Illinois Cops Expose Lululemon Shoplifting Scheme
description:
Four people were arrested after allegedly orchestrating a shoplifting scheme from a Lululemon in Lake Forest, Illinois. Officers took Romero Velcu, 18, Crina Dunca, 32, Stefan Florinel, 26, and Rebecca Velcu, 26, into custody after the group was accused of working together to stash nearly $5,000 worth of stolen merchandise in one of the suspect’s skirts. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
